sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block

The return and filtering system is standardized and based on a modular design. 
The exact fitting location on the oil tank module is freely selectable

The oil tank is installed above the turbine. The leakage oil coming from the 
turbine returns to the turbine. The leakage oil coming from the turbine returns 
to the lower leakage tank pump provides oil flow through the return filter and 
back to the oil tank the oil return from servo motor directly back to the oil 
tank
Filtering of leakage oil, control of the filters and control of the oil.

The first draft initiated 
and tested 
 by eng.
Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamed Metwaly, accepted by eng.
Abd El-Karem Mousa Ahmed: mechanical maintenance director,
approved by eng. Yousef Mahmoud Aly:

يجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
The unit must be out of service.

The leakge oil tank should be emply 
 from oil (overhaul capital maintenance annually)

Change the double oil filters.

Check that no oil leakage from tank, on a monthly maintenance clean the

 inside.
